summary.text: Historical data is provided by S&P Global Market Intelligence. Real-time stock price data is provided by CBOE and 15-minute delayed consolidated tape pricing data is provided by Nasdaq UTP. Several fund data points are also provided by Finnhub.

overview.description: The Morgan Stanley Pathway Small-Mid Cap Equity ETF (MSSM) is an exchange-traded fund that mostly invests in extended market equity. The fund seeks capital appreciation through an actively managed portfolio of US mid- and small-cap equity securities. The fund utilizes a multi-manager strategy in constructing the portfolio. MSSM was launched on Nov 18, 1991 and is issued by Morgan Stanley.

holdings.infoBox: MSSM is an equity ETF with a total of 1838 individual holdings. The top holdings are Us Dollars stock at 1.64%, Dynatrace at 0.89%, Ascendis Pharma at 0.71%, Viasat at 0.68%, and Veeco Instruments at 0.62%.
